previous_turn_classification: progress: C17 counterexamples and C18 three-mechanism experiment changed the next action
current_turn_classification: progress: quantified omitted-shunt bias, joint-fit noise fragility, and exact readout-drift nonidentifiability
scope: Conditional stable scalar feedback model; no actual animal endpoint, anatomical graph reconstruction or CE-specific test.

limits: Optimizer success is not accurate recovery; bounded fits can terminate with large bias.
These are pooled development-grid error quantiles, not population confidence intervals or biological power.
Exact calibration comparator assumes zero calibration error and is therefore optimistic.
Full local sensitivity rank and recovery on 36 cases do not prove global identifiability over all circuits.
The filter counterexample concerns an unconstrained changing transfer function, not every calibrated acquisition model.

answers.refuted: The C18 ideal intervention result can be transferred to conductance interventions without modeling shunt; arbitrary recording drift still permits unique mechanism recovery.
answers.survives: Three-mechanism recovery is conditional on model adequacy and independently calibrated intervention/readout. Explicit nuisance modeling can recover the noiseless fixed grid.
answers.next_allowed: Receive an actual measurement bundle and first verify provenance, same-unit identity, calibration, native timing and model applicability. If inputs are absent, stop biological inference rather than manufacture an observed endpoint.

required_user_or_external_input.request_sent: A path to same-cell pre/post voltage and delivered-current recordings, independent intervention calibration and cell/connection identity.
minimum_content: Native timestamps with raw voltage, external probe and delivered-current traces
Biological preparation, animal/cell/connection identity and intervention/sham/recovery labels
Independent effective coupling-dose calibration and its uncertainty
Measured membrane time/resistance and shunt or sufficient independent measurements to identify them
For anatomy: same-preparation path/connection measurements rather than only an aggregate fitted delay
required_user_or_external_input.current_evidence_availability: No such bundle is supplied or named in Q-NPF-04. Existing C18/C19 artifacts are synthetic. This is not a claim that no suitable dataset exists anywhere.
required_user_or_external_input.other_lineage: The existing adult L4 lab handoff reports external actions remaining and no biological endpoint. It is a different preparation/contract and cannot be counted as C19 input or experimental execution.

completion_requirements_still_unproven: Actual biological anatomy/structure measurements and alternative-topology discrimination
Independent mechanism identification with selective controls
Generalization to independently held-out biological units
Original CE output-metric and behavioral chain if that specific theory is to be established
